en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand Eclectic/Neo‑Baroque bank palace on a square. The caption at the bottom reads "Üdvözlet Pécsről." and "Pécsi takarékpénztár." A vertical publisher credit appears at the left margin. The building façade also bears the inscription "PÉCSI TAKARÉKPÉNZTÁR." The reverse side has the Hungarian heading "Levelező‑lap" with dotted address lines.
